{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Colorado Interstate Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline system.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2kUPlGj Colorado Interstate Gas Pipeline,] Company, accessed September 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from the Rocky Mountains and the Anadarko Basin to Colorado, Wyoming, the Midwest, California, and the Northwest.

*'''Owner: '''Colorado Interstate Gas Co LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2000/11/27/00-30068/colorado-interstate-gas-company-notice-of-intent-to-prepare-an-environmental-assessment-for-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''87 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''53.2 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2000/11/27/00-30068/colorado-interstate-gas-company-notice-of-intent-to-prepare-an-environmental-assessment-for-the|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Background==
In June 1928, when the pipeline was first constructed, it comprised of 340 miles of 20- and 22-inch pipelines connecting Panhandle to Denver.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/3158172|title=Long-Distance Natural Gas Pipe Lines|last=Troxel|first=C. Emery|date=November 1936|website=www.jstor.org|language=en|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2023-08-23}}</ref> El Paso Pipeline Partners LP, a subsidiary of Kinder Morgan, acquired Colorado Interstate Gas Company LLC from El Paso Corporation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2012/El-Paso-Pipeline-Partners-Agrees-to-Acquire-Cheyenne-Plains-Pipeline-and-Additional-Interest-in-Colorado-Interstate-Gas-Company-From-El-Paso-Corporation/default.aspx|title=Kinder Morgan - El Paso Pipeline Partners Agrees to Acquire Cheyenne Plains Pipeline and Additional Interest in Colorado Interstate Gas Company From El Paso Corporation|last=|first=|date=18 may, 2012|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|language=en-US|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2023-08-23}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bizjournals.com/denver/stories/2009/07/27/daily12.html|title=El Paso Pipeline Partners acquires majority stake in Colorado Interstate Gas|last=|first=|date=27 July, 2009|website=www.bizjournals.com|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2023-08-23}}</ref> 

Colorado Interstate Gas Company, L.L.C., a subsidiary of Kinder Morgan, operates the 4,300 mile pipeline system which delivers gas from production areas in the Rocky Mountains and the Anadarko Basin to Colorado, Wyoming, the midwest, Southern California, and the Pacific Northwest.<ref>[https://www.kindermorgan.com/pages/business/gas_pipelines/west/CIG/default.aspx Colorado Interstate Gas Pipeline,] Kinder Morgan, accessed December 2017</ref>  The pipeline system is a capacity of 5.15 bcf/d.<ref>[https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=3127640 Company Overview of Colorado Interstate Gas Company, L.L.C.,] Bloomberg, accessed December 2017</ref>
